summary: Receive orders reliably, buffer ERP outages and avoid duplicate business processing. Proposed only; no resources deployed.

requirements.title: Accept order requests through REST
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A caller receives a durable acceptance identifier only after recording the request

requirements.title: Process 20,000 orders per day
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Sustain 20,000 synthetic accepted orders in a 24-hour load test with peak capacity measured separately

requirements.title: Tolerate ERP outages of 45 minutes
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Pending orders remain recoverable after a simulated 45-minute ERP outage

requirements.title: Prevent duplicate ERP business processing
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: Replaying a confirmed order does not create a second ERP order

requirements.title: Deliver accepted orders to ERP
requirements.acceptanceCriteria: A successfully processed order is correlated to exactly one ERP business record; retries reconcile uncertain outcomes

components.title: Order intake and state store
components.azureService: Azure Functions and transactional data store
components.responsibility: Atomic insert-if-absent and durable acceptance via an outbox

components.title: Queue and outbox relay
components.responsibility: Durable messaging with retry and dead-letter handling

components.title: ERP processing worker
components.responsibility: Lease-safe monotonic state transitions, ERP idempotency and reconciliation

decisions.title: Asynchronous order processing
decisions.rationale: ERP may be unavailable while intake remains available

decisions.title: Transactional outbox and idempotent consumer
decisions.rationale: Avoid state-write race and persistence/enqueue gap

implementationTasks.title: Design intake transaction and idempotency key
implementationTasks.verification: Review insert-if-absent and outbox atomicity tests
implementationTasks.rollback: Do not expose endpoint until verified

implementationTasks.title: Configure queue, worker retries and DLQ

testCases.title: ERP unavailable for 45 minutes
testCases.expectedResult: Orders stay recoverable and are processed or reconciled when ERP returns

testCases.title: Duplicate submission
testCases.expectedResult: One ERP business order and a stable idempotency result

testCases.title: Daily throughput test
testCases.expectedResult: 20,000 accepted orders in 24 hours in approved test environment

testCases.title: Durable acceptance test
testCases.expectedResult: No acceptance acknowledgment before durable store commit

risks.title: ERP idempotency contract unconfirmed
risks.mitigation: Confirm ERP external reference support and implement reconciliation

openQuestions.title: What is peak orders per second?
What is the expected ERP idempotency mechanism?
